name: office
description: Essential office suite (LibreOffice), dictionaries and calendar
_comment: Note: LibreOffice, aspell & myspell dictionaries, and GNOME Calendar are default. Extra PDF readers (Evince, Okular, MuPDF) and office tools (CherryTree, Obsidian, Pandoc, GnuCash, Homebank, Recoll, AbiWord, Gnumeric, Scribus) are listed under 'optional_packages' to avoid duplications with desktop-native PDF readers (Okular in KDE, Atril in MATE).
